We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. Position Description Bridgenext is seeking an experienced GIS Developer to design, develop, test, maintain, and enhance geospatial applications and data-management solutions supporting timberland, agriculture, natural resources, and broader land-management operations. The role requires strong GIS development, spatial-data management, system-integration, automation, and modern web-development capabilities. The GIS Developer will build scalable solutions using the Esri ArcGIS platform, Python, SQL, Microsoft Azure services, and contemporary web technologies to support informed operational and investment decisions. The successful candidate will collaborate with GIS Analysts, Business Analysts, land managers, forestry and agriculture professionals, Product Owners, and technology teams to translate complex geospatial requirements into secure, reliable, and user-focused solutions. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain GIS web applications, geospatial services, and supporting data solutions. Build and support integrations between ArcGIS platforms and enterprise systems, including land-information management, forest operations, reporting, and environmental or safety platforms. Develop and maintain ArcGIS geoprocessing tools, Python/ArcPy automation, scheduled workflows, REST APIs, and reusable services for spatial processing and resource-management activities. Create, publish, administer, and optimize ArcGIS map services, feature services, geoprocessing services, image services, mobile data services, and offline map packages. Develop interactive mapping and responsive GIS applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, with appropriate authentication, authorization, and role-based access controls. Support backend and full-stack development for GIS applications using modern APIs, web technologies, and enterprise integration patterns. Manage and maintain enterprise geospatial datasets, parcel information, forest inventory, farmland and timberland boundaries, resource data, and related business attributes. Support spatial editing workflows for harvesting, regeneration, dispositions, casualty loss, exclusion areas, acreage tracking, leases, inspections, and field operations. Develop or support growth-and-yield modeling, forest-inventory analysis, spatial joins, overlays, and other geospatial analytics used in harvest planning and investment decisions. Ensure spatial-data integrity and consistency across ArcGIS, enterprise geodatabases, integrated applications, and downstream reporting platforms through validation, verification, and reconciliation controls. Write and optimize spatial SQL queries for Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL Managed Instance, including enterprise geodatabase administration, spatial indexing, reporting, migration, and domain management. Develop and support big-data geospatial workflows using Databricks, PySpark, GeoPandas, Databricks Mosaic, ADLS Gen2, Delta Lake, and Parquet where applicable. Develop solutions for mobile and offline field-data collection using ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, Collector, and custom field applications. Support Azure Active Directory group synchronization, Single Sign-On, least-privilege access, ArcGIS Portal group governance, and periodic access reviews. Participate in solution design, sprint planning, story refinement, estimation, testing, user acceptance, release activities, peer reviews, and continuous-improvement initiatives. Troubleshoot and resolve production issues involving spatial data, map and feature services, application integrations, performance, valuations, reporting, and field workflows. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployments using GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps or Harness, Artifactory, and related DevSecOps practices. Must Have Skills: Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 5+ years of professional experience in GIS application development and geospatial technologies. Strong hands-on experience with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Portal, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, and enterprise ArcGIS administration concepts. Proficiency in Python and ArcPy for geoprocessing, spatial automation, data migration, and administrative workflows. Strong SQL and database-development experience, including spatial data types, enterprise geodatabases/SDE, spatial indexing, and query optimization. Experience developing web applications using JavaScript or TypeScript, React, and the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. Knowledge of ArcGIS REST APIs, RESTful service design, system integrations, and secure API consumption. Experience creating and supporting map, feature, geoprocessing, image, and mobile/offline GIS services. Experience with Databricks, PySpark, GeoPandas, Databricks Mosaic, Delta Lake, ADLS Gen2, Parquet, and large-scale spatial analytics. Experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud-based GIS or application environments. Working knowledge of Azure Active Directory, SSO, role-based access, and enterprise security controls. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, spatial-data validation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders and translate functional geospatial requirements into technical solutions. Preferred Skills: Experience in forestry, timberland, agriculture, natural resources, real assets, or land-management domains. Experience with timber harvest applications, forest inventory, growth-and-yield modeling, parcel management, farmland operations, or environmental and safety systems. Hands-on experience with ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, Collector, mobile field solutions, and offline GIS workflows. Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, enterprise data lakes, data governance, and spatially enabled reporting solutions. Knowledge of .NET/C#, Java, FastAPI, React Native, Flutter, or other technologies used to integrate GIS with enterprise and mobile applications. Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Harness, JFrog Artifactory, Jira, and Confluence. Familiarity with ArcMap/Citrix legacy environments and modernization or migration to ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Enterprise. Professional Skills: Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, with the ability to explain technical GIS concepts to business and operational stakeholders. Collaborative team player who can work effectively with GIS Analysts, Business Analysts, land managers, field teams, and cross-functional technology squads. High standards of professionalism, ownership, documentation, code quality, and production support. Self-sufficient and organized, with the ability to prioritize concurrent development, support, and data-quality activities. Flexible and improvement-oriented, with sound judgment and a practical approach to solving complex spatial and integration problems. Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

full_description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 2 years of experience with software development in C++, Java, Python, or Go programming languages. Experience building and developing large-scale infrastructure or distributed systems. Preferred qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field. Experience in building and managing services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar cloud environments (e.g., using Kubernetes, Cloud Run). Experience with high-availability load balancing and networking technologies. Deep knowledge of cloud security concepts, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and Zero Trust architectures Deep understanding of agentic workflows including Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. About the job Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. The team is securing the next generation of generative AI and agentic applications with a deny-by-default security perimeter for Artificial Intelligence (AI). It automatically enforces dynamic ingress and egress guardrails on every interaction between agents, models, tools and data across the enterprise. Building on Google Cloud's identity and policy stack (e.g., Identity and Access Management (IAM) Unified Access Policies, Principal Access Boundaries, Identity-Aware Proxy, Agent Gateway and Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Service Controls), we turn intent such as "this agent may read tickets but never delete records" into context-aware boundaries that are enforced at runtime.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Responsibilities Design, build, and deploy data-plane and control-plane components enforcing deny-by-default AI policies. Own features from design through launch, and help shape your roadmap. Build low-latency services that evaluate identity, context, and policy at Google Cloud scale. Author design docs and weigh performance, reliability, and maintenance trade-offs with senior engineers. Partner with Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud Run, IAM, and Agent Platform to integrate your features. Help define API agreements and integration details, and flag cross-team blockers early. Find and fix component risks, from policy correctness to failure modes and abuse paths. Join on-call response, resolve production incidents, and ensure fixes land. Turn requirements into clear milestones, estimate reliably, and deliver on schedule. Steer features through launch, including dry-runs and safe enforcement. Write clean, tested, documented code. Conduct thorough code reviews, and mentor Level3 engineers and interns. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: AI Ops Engineer
skills: Python, Microservices, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD
full_description: The Ford Credit Global Data Insights and Analytics (FC - GDIA) department is looking for a motivated and talented AI – Ops Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI operations expertise to build, automate, and secure the platform that powers our advanced artificial intelligence solutions for the Ford Credit team. In this role, you will act as the backbone of our quantitative analytics and AI engineering teams. Your primary mission will be to design, automate, and operate the end-to-end cloud and AI infrastructure — including CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, observability, and platform guardrails — so that our Generative AI applications and modelers can run safely, scalably, and reliably in production. Cloud Platform Engineering: Architect and operate highly available, multi-service AI infrastructure on the cloud, managing the full lifecycle of compute, storage, networking, and security for AI workloads. AI-Ops / LLMOps Pipelines: Establish robust MLOps and LLMOps pipelines covering the end-to-end lifecycle of Generative AI tools — including model deployment, version control, prompt and artifact tracking, automated evaluation, and continuous monitoring for performance, drift, and hallucination mitigation. CI/CD Automation: Design and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines for full-stack AI applications, ensuring seamless and secure continuous integration and delivery across front-end, back-end, and AI components. Infrastructure as Code: Manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Build, Kubernetes manifests) to deliver reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments. Containerization & Orchestration: Build and operate containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), managing scaling, rolling deployments, resource optimization, and service resilience for AI workloads. Observability & Reliability: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and SRE practices to ensure platform reliability, availability, and performance of AI applications in production. Security & Governance: Embed security across the platform — identity and access management, secrets management, network policies, and data protection — ensuring all AI workloads meet Ford's strict data privacy, security, and compliance standards. Developer Enablement: Work closely with AI engineers, software engineers, and analytical modelers to provide self-service tooling, environments, and automated workflows that remove friction from development to production. Skills Knowledge Required Cloud Platform: Extensive hands-on experience with a leading cloud provider (e.g., Google Cloud Platform), including Cloud Run, Cloud Build, GKE, GCS, BigQuery, IAM, VPC networking, and Secret Manager. DevOps / SRE Practices: Strong proficiency in CI/CD tooling, GitOps, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud-native monitoring and logging. AI-Ops / LLMOps: Proficiency in tools and platforms for model deployment, prompt/model versioning, evaluation, tracing, and monitoring of LLM and GenAI outputs. Scripting & Automation: Hands-on experience with a programming/scripting language such as Python, or Bash for automating infrastructure and operational tasks, and for building tooling that serves collaborators. Software Engineering Fundamentals: Working knowledge of full-stack application architecture and modern deployment patterns for AI tools, with the ability to integrate front-end, back-end, and AI services reliably. Security & Compliance: Familiarity with cloud security best practices, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance standards in regulated environments. Analytics Workflow Understanding: Awareness of the typical workflows of data scientists and modelers (data wrangling, feature engineering, model validation) so you can build reliable platforms and pipelines that serve them. Qualifications Experience Education: Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline. DevOps/Cloud Engineering Experience: 3–5 years of overall experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or SRE, with at least 1–2 years of dedicated, hands-on experience deploying and operating AI, ML, and Generative AI applications in production. full_description: ML Engineer - Simulation (Universal Robots, Bangalore - India) ID: 12960 Function: Engineering Location: Bangalore, IN Our Purpose TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results. Universal Robots, part of Teradyne Robotics, is the world market leader in collaborative robots (cobots), making products that empower our customers and positively transform the way they work. Teradyne Robotics is a division of Teradyne and includes Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR). Our global R&D organization of 200+ engineers builds the software and systems behind every cobot we ship. Opportunity Overview You will join a team of talented and passionate engineers developing, testing, and optimizing the software and firmware running on our various robot platforms. As an ML Engineer on the Simulation team, you will train, evaluate, and ship the perception and 3D generation models that power our simulation platform for UR cobots and MiR mobile robots. Simulation is central to how we reduce integration time, validate fleet behaviour, and let customers model their own environments and workflows ahead of deployment — and increasingly, the assets, scenes, and perception capabilities inside those simulations are learned rather than hand-built. This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of computer vision, 3D deep learning, and robotics. You will work closely with our Senior ML Research Scientist to turn research ideas into robust, production-ready models — covering object detection, pose estimation, 3D asset generation, image-to-3D reconstruction, and related tasks — and you will build the data, training, and evaluation pipelines that make them reproducible at scale. You will also collaborate with robotics engineers who integrate your models into the simulation platform, with application engineers who understand real customer deployments, and with the wider R&D organization in Denmark and Bangalore. Your responsibilities and tasks include: Train, fine-tune, and evaluate deep learning models for object detection, instance segmentation, and object and human pose estimation across industrial, manufacturing, and warehouse environments. Develop and train models for 3D asset generation and image-to-3D reconstruction, producing simulation-ready meshes, textures, and materials from images, scans, or text descriptions. Work alongside the ML team to prototype, reproduce, and productionise state-of-the-art methods — including diffusion models, transformers, NeRF, and Gaussian splatting — taking them from paper to working pipeline. Build scalable, reproducible training pipelines across cloud and on-premises GPU clusters, including distributed training, experiment tracking, and model versioning. Generate and curate synthetic training data from the simulation platform using domain randomisation and procedural scene variation, and combine it with real-world robot and camera data. Develop data collection, annotation, preprocessing, and quality-control pipelines for 2D and 3D datasets, including auto-labelling workflows that scale with simulation throughput. Post-process generated 3D assets — mesh cleanup, texturing, collision geometry, and physical properties — so they import reliably into simulation environments (USD, URDF, SDF). Define evaluation metrics, benchmarks, and test sets for perception and 3D generation quality, and measure how well models trained on synthetic data transfer to real deployments. Optimise models for inference speed and memory footprint (quantisation, ONNX, TensorRT) and package them as services or modules that integrate cleanly into the simulation stack. Work with robotics engineers to integrate trained models and generated assets into production simulation workflows and ROS2-based pipelines. Write clean, well-tested, and documented code, and participate actively in code reviews to uphold engineering standards across the team. Contribute to CI/CD and MLOps tooling that keeps models continuously trained, validated, and deployable. Stay current with advances in computer vision, 3D generative AI, and embodied intelligence, and share relevant findings with the team. All About You We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you're ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position. We value diversity in culture, competence, and experience. We expect you to bring a number of qualifications to be considered for this role. Mandatory Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field. 3+ years of professional experience training and deploying machine learning models, with a significant focus on computer vision. Strong programming proficiency in Python, with a demonstrated ability to write production-quality, maintainable code; working knowledge of C++ is an advantage. Hands-on experience with PyTorch (or JAX), including building custom models, loss functions, data loaders, and training loops. Practical experience training and evaluating models for at least one of: object detection, segmentation, pose estimation, or 3D reconstruction / generation. Solid understanding of deep learning and computer vision fundamentals — CNNs and transformers, camera models and projective geometry, coordinate transforms, and standard evaluation metrics. Experience building data and training pipelines, including dataset versioning, experiment tracking (e.g. Weights & Biases, MLflow), and reproducible workflows. Comfortable working in a Linux environment with GPUs, version control, containerisation, and modern development workflows. Proficiency required in at least five of the following qualifications: 3D deep learning and generative models for 3D content — diffusion-based 3D generation, image-to-3D, multi-view reconstruction, or text-to-3D. Neural scene representations such as NeRF, Gaussian splatting, or implicit surface models. 6D object pose estimation and tracking, or human pose and keypoint estimation. Modern detection and segmentation frameworks and vision foundation models (e.g. YOLO, DETR-family, Detectron2, SAM, Grounding DINO, DINOv2). Synthetic data generation and domain randomisation using simulators or rendering engines (Isaac Sim / Replicator, Omniverse, Blender, BlenderProc, Unity). 3D geometry processing and asset pipelines (USD, URDF, SDF, mesh processing, Open3D, Trimesh, PyTorch3D). Distributed and large-scale GPU training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, mixed precision) across multi-node clusters. Model optimisation and deployment — ONNX, TensorRT, quantisation, and inference serving such as Triton. Cloud infrastructure and orchestration — AWS, Azure, or GCP, with Docker and Kubernetes. MLOps practices including model registries, automated evaluation, and CI/CD for machine learning. Robotics fundamentals and ROS / ROS2, including camera and depth sensor integration. Sim-to-real transfer and domain adaptation methods for perception models. Publications, open-source contributions, or competition results in computer vision or 3D learning. Personal Attributes Candidates should demonstrate ambition, organizational skills, and adaptability. Independence, initiative, responsibility, and ownership are vital. A pragmatic approach, commitment to continuous learning, and dedication to work quality are expected. What We Offer At Universal Robots we set a high bar and in return we provide an exciting career in a fast-growing, technology-driven company where you work alongside skilled and talented colleagues from around the world. Global team, local impact — Be part of a world-class R&D organisation managed from Denmark while making a tangible difference from our Bangalore office every day. Growth and development — A manager with continuous focus on team spirit, employee development, and skill building. Empowerment — Ownership of your work and the products you help create; we trust our engineers to make informed decisions that benefit the organisation. Health insurance and additional benefits. On-site collaboration with co-located product and software teams, fostering strong working relationships and rapid feedback. We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. full_description: At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. So, what’s the role all about? NICE Public Safety provides a cloud based enterprise product used by public safety and justice agencies. Our customers depend on this product for time sensitive work, so the system has to be available at all times. We are looking for an Associate Technical Support Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team in Pune. This is an early career role for someone with 1 to 3 years of experience who wants to build a strong foundation in cloud monitoring and production support. The main purpose of the role is to watch the health of our product hosted on Microsoft Azure, respond to alerts, carry out first level troubleshooting and escalate issues to senior engineers with clear and complete information. The person will work under the guidance of senior Technical Support Engineers and is expected to learn quickly, follow established SOPs and gradually take on more ownership. We also expect them to be curious about AI tools such as Claude and Copilot and willing to use them in their daily work. How will you make an impact? Monitor production systems on Azure using tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana and Kibana. Watch alert queues and dashboards, acknowledge alerts promptly and act on them as per the defined SOPs. Carry out first level troubleshooting by reviewing logs, metrics and recent changes, and document findings clearly. Raise and track incidents in the ticketing tool, escalate to senior engineers or Advanced Support on time and with complete information. Assist senior engineers during major incidents by gathering logs, running health checks and keeping notes. Help reduce false alarms by reporting noisy or misfiring alerts to the senior team. Use AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to help read logs, summaries incidents and draft updates. Write simple scripts to automate routine tasks such as reports and health checks, with guidance from senior engineers. Share clear and timely updates with internal stakeholders during incidents. Follow and help update SOPs, knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides. Meet the defined SLAs, KPIs and escalation processes. Have you got what it takes? 1 to 3 years of experience in technical support, application support, NOC, production monitoring or cloud operations.
